review_method: Every image inspected visually at original 1024x1536 resolution for scientific accuracy, text integrity, explanatory value, visual richness and mobile readability.

pairs.prompt_summary: Loss-type wheel and five-scene response network covering crop, livestock and direct encounters, the 2021–26 strategy and AP H.A.N.U.M.A.N.
pairs.review: accepted; clear loss-to-remedy mapping and field-response chain

pairs.prompt_summary: Field scientist routes abundance, identity, movement, presence, habitat and patrol questions to the correct evidence methods.
pairs.review: accepted; strongest explanatory pair, exact M-STrIPES limitation retained

pairs.prompt_summary: Five large mammals shown in habitat islands with status, threat and conservation action; all CITES I and highest Indian protection.
pairs.review: full image regenerated because first attempt became a dense row-table with decorative slogans; replacement is landscape-led and factually cleaner

pairs.prompt_summary: Bustard, gharial, river dolphin and dugong placed in ecological niches with threat-to-response stories.
pairs.review: accepted; accurate habitat specialisation and crocodilian comparison

pairs.prompt_summary: Four causal stories: trafficking, diclofenac poisoning, provisional acoustic evidence and arribada nesting.
pairs.review: independently corrected: removed unverified CITES claim for Jerdon's Courser; redrew olive ridleys with rounded olive-grey carapace, compact body and relatively small head; full replacement contains no added slogan or unsupported fact

pairs.prompt_summary: Three endemic/restricted-range habitat portraits and their distinct trade, grassland and montane recovery pathways.
pairs.review: accepted; no-CITES Nilgiri tahr distinction and reintroduction terminology are explicit

pairs.prompt_summary: Western Ghats canopy, open grassland and Seshachalam rocky-slope species with an Andhra Pradesh locator.
pairs.review: full image regenerated after first attempt gave Jerdon's Courser the wrong IUCN status and added slogan text; replacement correctly shows CR and accurate AP localities

pairs.prompt_summary: NWAP 2017–2031 visual roadmap from policy framework and numeric structure to five field outcomes.
pairs.review: accepted; policy/non-statutory distinction and non-replacement of species projects retained

pairs.prompt_summary: Chronology separates HWC Centre announcement/inauguration, four-project Wildlife Week package and AP H.A.N.U.M.A.N. launch.
pairs.review: accepted; event grouping and verbs announced/unveiled/launched/inaugurated are clear

pairs.prompt_summary: Dated evidence tags and six recent estimates teach number plus method/source plus date.
pairs.review: final original-resolution review: Ganges river dolphin has long narrow beak, tiny eye and low dorsal ridge; all six verified estimate panels are preserved; meaningless filler was removed and the bottom rule now reads ALWAYS REPORT: NUMBER + METHOD/SOURCE + REFERENCE DATE

pairs.prompt_summary: Three parallel panels distinguish recognition counts, plan periods and IBCA legal milestones.
pairs.review: full image regenerated after first attempt attached an incorrect 2023 date to 101 Ramsar Sites; final omits that false date while concept image carries the required August 2026 qualifier

rejections.reason: First version was a dense row-table and included decorative slogans instead of landscape-based explanation.
First version incorrectly labelled Jerdon's Courser Near Threatened and added unsupported slogan-like copy.
First version incorrectly printed 101 Ramsar Sites as of 2023.
Second corrective attempt invented plan names and changed IBCA milestone meanings; rejected entirely.
Independent QA found the original concept carried an unverified CITES Appendix I claim for Jerdon's Courser and the turtle read as a green turtle.
First morphology correction introduced decorative slogans and extra unsupported detail; rejected and regenerated again.
Original river-dolphin panel depicted bottlenose/marine dolphin morphology.
Original river-dolphin panel depicted bottlenose/marine dolphin morphology.

Two later C11 drafts removing 95/96 were discarded after source recheck confirmed that facts f040 and f042 intentionally support August 2026 and the potential-range-countries distinction; final C11 assets were not replaced by those drafts.
